title: WaveCheckpoint
description: Rollback state written by Decompose at each wave boundary. Read by Rollback to restore prior state.

checkpoint_id.description: Unique checkpoint identifier (UUID or wave-scoped slug)

task_id.description: Task card ID this checkpoint belongs to

wave_index.description: Zero-based wave index within the task

wave_label.description: Human-readable wave name (e.g., Wave 1 — Schema Design)

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when checkpoint was written

receipts_written.description: Paths to receipts written in this wave

files_modified.description: Files created or modified in this wave (for rollback diffing)

prior_hash.description: SHA-256 of file content before this wave (null if created)

state_snapshot.description: Key wave-state values preserved for rollback reconstruction

rollback_safe.description: True when all wave outputs are reversible without side effects

rollback_blockers.description: Reasons rollback may be unsafe (e.g., external API calls made)
